sentences.text_target: It is Monday morning.
sentences.text_native: C'est lundi matin.

sentences.text_target: It is time for work.
sentences.text_native: C'est l'heure de travailler.

sentences.text_target: The office is very busy today.
sentences.text_native: Le bureau est très animé aujourd'hui.

sentences.text_target: Tom walks to the meeting room.
sentences.text_native: Tom se dirige vers la salle de réunion.

sentences.text_target: He opens the heavy door.
sentences.text_native: Il ouvre la lourde porte.

sentences.text_target: The room is large and quiet.
sentences.text_native: La pièce est grande et calme.

sentences.text_target: Bright light comes through the window.
sentences.text_native: Une lumière vive entre par la fenêtre.

sentences.text_target: A big table stands in the middle.
sentences.phonetic: /ə bɪɡ ˈteɪbəl stændz ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl/
sentences.text_native: Une grande table se trouve au milieu.

sentences.text_target: Many chairs wait around the table.
sentences.text_native: De nombreuses chaises attendent autour de la table.

sentences.text_target: The boss sits at the front.
sentences.text_native: Le patron s'assoit au bout de la table.

sentences.text_target: Another colleague enters the room.
sentences.text_native: Un autre collègue entre dans la pièce.

sentences.text_target: Everyone takes a comfortable seat.
sentences.text_native: Tout le monde s'installe confortablement.

sentences.text_target: Tom puts his computer on the wood.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm pʊts hɪz kəmˈpjuːtər ɒn ðə wʊd/
sentences.text_native: Tom pose son ordinateur sur la table.

sentences.text_target: He has a paper and a pen ready.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː hæz ə ˈpeɪpər ænd ə pɛn ˈrɛdi/
sentences.text_native: Il a du papier et un stylo prêts.

sentences.text_target: The team starts the important meeting.
sentences.text_native: L'équipe commence cette réunion importante.

sentences.text_target: The boss speaks about a new project.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə bɒs spiːks əˈbaʊt ə njuː ˈprɒdʒɛkt/
sentences.text_native: Le patron parle d'un nouveau projet.

sentences.text_target: Everyone listens to him carefully.
sentences.text_native: Tout le monde l'écoute attentivement.

sentences.text_target: They look at the main goal.
sentences.text_native: Ils examinent l'objectif principal.

sentences.text_target: Tom thinks about a smart plan.
sentences.text_native: Tom réfléchit à un plan ingénieux.

sentences.text_target: He shares his smart idea now.
sentences.text_native: Il partage sa bonne idée maintenant.

sentences.text_target: A colleague asks a difficult question.
sentences.text_native: Un collègue pose une question difficile.

sentences.text_target: They talk about a small problem.
sentences.text_native: Ils discutent d'un petit problème.

sentences.text_target: Tom finds a good solution quickly.
sentences.text_native: Tom trouve rapidement une bonne solution.

sentences.text_target: All workers agree with his plan.
sentences.text_native: Tous les collaborateurs approuvent son plan.

sentences.text_target: They write the next step down.
sentences.text_native: Ils notent la prochaine étape.

sentences.text_target: The meeting finishes on time.
sentences.text_native: La réunion se termine à l'heure.

sentences.text_target: People pack their things up.
sentences.text_native: Chacun range ses affaires.

sentences.text_target: Tom closes his computer screen.
sentences.text_native: Tom ferme son ordinateur portable.

sentences.text_target: They leave the room together.
sentences.text_native: Ils quittent la pièce ensemble.

sentences.text_target: Hard work continues outside.
sentences.text_native: Le travail reprend de plus belle.
